name: Icon
description: One Lucide icon from the registry (D-017) at four sizes, or in a soft-colored tile. Decorative unless it has a label. Directional icons mirror in RTL.

livewire.name: icon
capabilities: Names outside the registry fall back to blade-icons, so the 2.x heroicon (o-plus) and Font Awesome (fas.user) names keep rendering, through the ap.livewireUiComponents.iconAlias filter

props.name: name
props.description: A registered icon name, Lucide's kebab-case (house, arrow-right). The default slot (children) overrides it with your own <svg>.

props.name: variant
props.description: plain is the bare glyph; tile puts it on a soft-colored rounded square (the root also gets the apui-icon-tile class). Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The glyph: 14, 16, 20 or 24px. A tile is 32, 40, 48 or 56px around a 16, 16, 20 or 24px glyph. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: color
props.description: A plain icon takes the color's text tone; a tile takes its soft fill and soft foreground. Unset, a plain icon draws in currentColor and a tile is neutral. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. With it the icon is role=img with aria-label; without it the icon is decorative and aria-hidden.
props.a11y: Label an icon that carries meaning on its own. Next to text that says the same thing, leave it decorative.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Flips the glyph in RTL. Unset, it follows the registry: arrow-left, arrow-right, chevron-left and chevron-right (and names an app marks directional) mirror. Emitted as data-mirror.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part: { root, svg }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Sizes and colors the glyph; in the tile variant it is the tile. role=img with aria-label when labeled, else aria-hidden.

parts.name: svg
parts.description: The registry's 24×24 Lucide glyph, stroke 1.5 in currentColor. Not rendered when the default slot gives your own <svg>.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Your own <svg>, drawn in place of the named icon at the same size. Keep it on a 24px grid in currentColor.

requirements: Decorative icons (no label) are aria-hidden, so screen readers skip them.
A labeled icon is role=img with aria-label; the svg inside stays aria-hidden.
Directional icons mirror under RTL; others (trends, clocks, external links) never do.
A plain icon draws in currentColor, so it meets the contrast of the text around it; colored icons use the color's text tone (4.5:1).
A tile's soft foreground meets 3:1 against its fill in every theme, and the tile gets an edge in high contrast (D-035).
